feature: ADR-0103 preserve causal batch action duration behind stage FIFO or actor time
abi: Pure Rust scheduler, no unsafe/FFI/dependency/ABI changes; oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Shared timeline/actor behavior changed; native compilation and earlier shared validations pending approval quota issue.

limitations: Per-stage whole-batch shift for monotonic action sequences; independently staged queues preserve FIFO and causal order.
Overflow rejects original entire owned batch without queue/order mutation; no saturating addition. Actor source/batch/slot state advances only after successful timeline admission.
Logical earliest/delivered times, not hard real-time or actual OS submission interval. Old queued deadlines retained; newly admitted past batches shifted behind current actor time.
Native Engine duration gate remains; complete simple/complex deferred actor/runtime integration still unfinished. TerminalActor is output-stage only.
Tests are deterministic pure actors and existing no-input process harnesses; no actual keyboard/native duration/input/device/driver/install actions.
